why: Legs took swings, zercher, deadlifts and step-ups yesterday, so today headlines loaded carries and upper work. Every 2 minutes: one station, then a leg — the clock is the rest.

blocks.title: THE MULE · E2MOM · 12 ROUNDS · 24:00
blocks.meta: EVERY 2:00 × 12 ROUNDS · 6 stations run twice · 60 lb / 2×45 lb / 52 lb / 35 lb
blocks.format: On the top of every 2:00: the station, then the leg. Whatever is left of the 2:00 is your rest. Stations run S1→S6, then S1→S6 again.
blocks.workRest: 12 run legs. ODD rounds · 0.10 mi @ 8.5 flat. EVEN rounds · 0.08 mi @ 6.0 / 8% grade. 1.08 mi total.

items.name: S1 · Farmer carry 2×45 lb · 40 yd out + back
S3 · Bear-hug carry 60 lb · 30 yd out + back
items.detail: bell high on the chest, ribs down

items.name: S5 · Bottoms-up rack carry 35 lb · 20 yd/side
STRETCH · rounds 13–14 · repeat S1 and S6

blocks.noteGreen: Score = rounds finished inside the 2:00. Green 12. Log your score, the first round you ran over, and RPE.
blocks.text: Bottoms-up carry: bell upside down, elbow tight to the ribs, forearm vertical — if it tips, reset and keep walking. Get-up at 60: roll to elbow, to hand, hips up, sweep the leg, stand. Bear-hug carry: squeeze the bell, breathe through the belt of the ribs.
